parameters.jsonBody: ={ "contents": [ { "parts": [ { "text": "Extract the data from this receipt and return ONLY a valid JSON object. Do not include any markdown formatting, conversational text, or explanations. You must strictly use this EXACT JSON structure. If a value cannot be found, use null for strings or 0 for numbers. Most receipts are from businesses in Pakistan: if no currency is explicitly shown, or the symbol is Rs or ₨, use PKR. The category field MUST be EXACTLY one of these seven values: Food, Fuel, Travel, Supplies, Utilities, Repairs, Other. Choose the single closest match, and use Other if unsure. Structure: { \"is_receipt\": true, \"vendor_name\": \"Merchant Name\", \"date\": \"YYYY-MM-DD\", \"receipt_number\": \"Invoice or Receipt Number\", \"payment_method\": \"Cash, Visa, etc.\", \"tax_id\": \"Vendor Tax ID or VAT\", \"category\": \"Food\", \"currency\": \"PKR\", \"subtotal\": 0.00, \"tax\": 0.00, \"total\": 0.00, \"ai_confidence\": 0.95, \"ai_flag\": \"Notes on blurriness or missing data (or null if perfect)\", \"items\": [ { \"description\": \"Item name\", \"qty\": 1, \"unit_price\": 0.00, \"amount\": 0.00 } ] }. If the image is NOT a receipt, return exactly this JSON and nothing else: { \"is_receipt\": false }" }, { "inlineData": { "mimeType": "{{ $('Image to Base64').first().json.mimeType }}", "data": "{{ $('Image to Base64').first().json.base64Image }}" } } ] } ], "generationConfig": { "responseMimeType": "application/json" } }
